                            (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            objects.append((color, cells))

    # Select the large L-shaped object on the grid edge as the color marker.

    # The target is the largest component diagonally opposite the L's arms.
